nodes.body:
Screenshot of the new **Settings → Talk** page (mock dev harness, `pnpm dev:ui:mock`), with `gpt-live-1-codex` selected so the GPT-Live explainer row is visible. Note the curated Model picker and the raw schema field below showing the same value — both patch the shared config draft, so they cannot drift.

Before: the `talk` section was a raw JSON-schema form on the Communications page (free-text inputs for provider/model/voice, no readiness signal, no model or voice lists).

![Talk settings page](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/pr-115409/talk-settings-page.png)

Merged via squash.
